# TopologyAwareRouting

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A routing mechanism within the interconnect that considers the logical neural topology (e.g., layers, recurrent loops, skip connections) to optimize spike delivery paths. This reduces communication latency and energy by aligning physical data movement with the logical structure of the neural network.
